observations: Photo 0 shows a black console lying flat, with sloped/curved side edges consistent with the original 'fat' PlayStation 4 body shape.
Two DualShock 4 style controllers sit on top of the console: one teal/mint body with red accents and red buttons, one purple/blue body with black sticks.
Both controllers show wear and scuffing on the touchpad area (scratched, dull finish).
No power cable, HDMI cable, or box is visible in the photo.
No screen-on shot, no boot menu, no jailbreak/HEN interface, and no game library screenshot are shown.
A watermark reading 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'EASY GAMES & GADGETS' overlays the image, indicating this is a reseller/listing photo, not necessarily the seller's own original photo.
No serial number, model sticker, or rear port panel is visible to confirm exact PS4 variant.

identity.kind: PS4 fat console with two wireless controllers

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a body shape consistent with original PS4 'fat' model, but no model/serial sticker or rear port panel is visible to confirm it is not a Slim/Pro variant.
No screen-on photo, HEN/jailbreak menu, or firmware version screen is shown in photo 0.

claims.claim: with FC26 and 8 other games installed
claims.evidence: No game library screenshot, storage/HDD capacity shot, or in-game footage is provided.

risks.risk: Console may not actually be jailbroken, or the jailbreak may be unstable/outdated, which materially changes value versus a stock PS4.
risks.proof: A screen-on photo or short clip showing the HEN/jailbreak home screen or package installer.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a stock, unmodified PS4 fat (no hacked premium)

risks.risk: Claimed games (FC26 + 8 others) may not be installed, or storage may be too small to hold them all.
risks.proof: A screenshot of the PS4 game library/menu showing installed titles and remaining storage.
risks.if_unproven: priced as console only, with no games included

risks.risk: Console may not power on or may have internal faults (overheating, disc drive issues, HDD failure) not visible in a static photo.
risks.proof: A clip of the console powering on to the home screen, or a photo of the console running with HDMI output visible on a TV.

risks.risk: Controllers show visible wear on touchpad; analog stick drift or button responsiveness cannot be assessed from a still photo.
risks.proof: A short video showing stick movement and button presses registering on screen.
risks.if_unproven: priced as controllers in worn, unverified-function condition

risks.risk: No power cable or HDMI cable shown; buyer may need to source these separately, adding cost.
risks.proof: A photo showing the full accessory set (power cable, HDMI cable) laid out with the console.
risks.if_unproven: priced as console and controllers only, cables not included

proof_requests: Photo of the console powered on showing the home screen or a game running
Screenshot of the installed game library showing FC26 and the other 8 titles
Screen-on photo of the jailbreak/HEN menu to confirm hacked status
Close-up photo of the rear port panel and any model/serial sticker
Photo showing power cable and HDMI cable included
Short clip of each controller's sticks and buttons being used
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable by type as a PS4 fat console bundled with two controllers, but the seller's key value-adding claims (hacked status, bundled games) are unverifiable from the single photo, so it must be priced at worst case as a stock, untested console with worn controllers and no confirmed extras.
